cells.note: the store-tier half of abstention: the denial loop of 2026-07-07 started when asks and the assistant's own refusals were mined back into facts. The reply half (declining, no canary) is the brain tier

cells.title: TARGET: a recall question as the speech-to-text delivers it (no question mark: 'do you remember who my dentist is') stores nothing
cells.note: measured, not assumed: the regex 'remember ...' template stores 'User asked me to remember: who my dentist is' and the write-quality gate accepts it because only a trailing '?' or an interrogative OPENER marks a question - 'do you remember' is neither once the '?' is gone, and a voice transcript never has one
